products.name: Chì Xiá — Crimson Glow
products.description: A warm, magnetic scent built to draw connection close — pink pepper opens bright, tuberose and carnation bloom into something bolder, and amber with tonka bean settle into a lingering, skin-warm base. Composed around Fire and Earth, the elements that govern passion and grounded intimacy in the Five Element tradition.

products.name: Jīn Liú — Golden Flow
products.description: A crisp, clarifying opening of bergamot and yuzu gives way to clary sage, then settles into musk and ambergris — smooth, quiet, and expansive. Composed around Metal and Water, the elements associated with clarity, precision, and the flow of abundance.

products.name: Běi Chén — North Star
products.description: Cool eucalyptus opens into iris and fig, grounding into vetiver and oud — a scent for steady ambition and forward motion. Composed around Water and Wood, the elements tied to direction, wisdom, and growth.

products.name: Qīng Líng — Verdant Calm
products.description: Basil and lavender open fresh and herbal, geranium and violet soften at the heart, and vanilla with cashmeran ground it all in warmth. Composed around Wood and Earth, the elements governing vitality, growth, and ease in the body.

products.name: Wǔ Xíng — Five Elements
products.description: Our signature blend, touching every element at once — bergamot and peppermint at the top, rose and honey at the heart, amber and sandalwood at the base. A complete, balancing scent for whenever your chart needs a little of everything.

products.name: Personalized Chu Wu Blend
products.description: Perfect for first-time users or daily carry. Crafted around your elemental balance — every bottle is custom-made after your order is confirmed.

products.name: Personalized Chu Wu Blend
products.description: Ideal for everyday use with longer-lasting value. Crafted around your elemental balance — every bottle is custom-made after your order is confirmed.

products.notes:

Base: White Musk, Orris Root, Cedar, Vanilla
products.description: A sparkling citrus opening unfolds into delicate rose and jasmine, softened by white musk and a powdery finish. Clean, polished and quietly elegant.

Middle: Orange Blossom, Cypress, Pear, Black Pepper
Base: Neroli, White Musk
products.description: Bright bergamot and a touch of pepper meet orange blossom, crisp pear and green cypress. A soft musky finish rounds out a fresh floral scent with a spirited edge.

products.notes:
Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain
Middle: Neroli, Orange Blossom
Base: Amberwood, White Musk
products.description: Lemon, bergamot and green petitgrain open into luminous neroli and orange blossom. Soft amberwood and white musk bring a gentle warmth to this breezy citrus scent.

products.notes:
Top: Tea, Bergamot, Neroli, Cardamom
Middle: Osmanthus, Jasmine Sambac, Fig
Base: Mate, Musk, Violet, Cedarwood
products.description: Fresh tea and bergamot unfold into osmanthus, jasmine and a gentle touch of fig. Mate, soft musk and cedarwood create a delicate finish with a quietly distinctive character.

products.notes:

Base: Oakmoss, Pine, Fir, Leather, Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedar, Amber, Resins
products.description: Lavender, rosemary and cool mint lead into aromatic juniper and warm spice. Moss, woods and a touch of leather give this fresh herbal scent a grounded, rugged depth.

products.notes:

Base: Dark Chocolate, Patchouli, Vanilla, Incense, Amber, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Musk
products.description: Blackcurrant and earthy truffle introduce a rich orchid heart touched with spice. Dark chocolate, patchouli and incense deepen the finish, creating a dramatic floral scent with a warm, sensual character.

Middle: Seaweed, Calone, Hedione
Base: Musk, Ambroxan, Cedar
products.description: Bright citrus gives way to a bold marine heart of seaweed and airy aquatic notes. Musk, ambroxan and cedar create a deep mineral finish, evoking open water and salt-swept rocks.

Top: Ambrette Seeds
Middle: Sea Salt, Mineral Notes
Base: Sage
products.inspired_by: Jo Malone Sea Salt & Wood Sage
products.description: Soft ambrette meets sea salt and cool mineral notes, settling into earthy sage. Clean, airy and understated, this coastal scent evokes a quiet walk along a windswept shore.

Middle: Bulgarian Rose
Base: Ambergris, Musk
products.description: Crushed blackcurrant leaves and tart cassis bring a vivid green opening to dewy rose. A soft musky finish captures the intimate atmosphere of a leafy garden after rain.

Base: Citruses, Vetiver
products.inspired_by: Hermès Un Jardin Après la Mousson
products.description: Ginger and cardamom bring a lively warmth to watery florals and white ginger lily. Citrus and vetiver leave a fresh green impression, evoking a tropical garden after rain.

products.notes:

Base: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Heliotrope, Musk, Vetiver, Cedar

products.description: Lavender and clary sage open into supple leather, bitter almond and powdery orris. Tonka bean, amber and soft woods bring warmth to a smooth, self-assured scent.
